result.question: How can you help me related to my dog?
result.answer: I can help with general, non-clinical dog-care education and with organizing caregiver observations you explicitly provide. I can assist with grooming, routines, calm handling, enrichment, basic training, and preparing factual notes or questions for a veterinary visit. I cannot diagnose, assess health, interpret symptoms or photos, triage, choose medication, give doses, or recommend treatment; health concerns should go to a veterinarian, and urgent concerns to emergency veterinary care. No saved observations were supplied here, so I won’t make dog-specific claims.
